fullContent:
Mukta Bhasma 
 Reference – Rasaratna Samuchchaya 4/14-15, Rasatarangini. 
 Introduction 
 Mukta bhasma is an ayurvedic formulation. This is prepared from the pearls. This bhasma is used to reduce the extra heat present in the body. This is used to balance acid in the body. This contains many mineral inside its body like calcium, silicon, phosphorous, magnesium and manganese etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Pearls 
 Rose water 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take pearls and purify these. 
 Now grind the pearls and ground their powder with rose water. 
 Made its disc shaped cakes, dried them and heated in the absence of air in 500 degree Celsius for three hours. 
 Repeat this process up to three times and you got a white colored mukta bhasma, also known as pearl clax. 
 
 Dose 
 70 – 125 mg two times a day with honey or chyawanprash. 
 Indications 
 
 Hyperacidity 
 Calcium deficiency 
 Asthma 
 Cough 
 Insomnia 
 Digestion power 
 Anorexia 
 Gastritis 
 
 Contraindications 
 Should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
